svg.title: A sudden change compared with a gradual change, with their CUSUM lines
svg.desc: Left: a measure that drops suddenly at point 25. The analyser finds two stages, and the CUSUM is two straight lines meeting at a sharp corner. Right: a measure that improves gradually between points 15 and 45. The analyser describes it as four stages, and the CUSUM is a smooth, rounded curve with no sharp corner.
svg.text: Stage averages found by the analyser
